name: Ranger: Incendiary Shot's client tooltip shows the ranged-slot cast time the server uses (#10138)
contract: Incendiary Shot 524870 is a ranged-slot spell (SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT 0x2, Attributes 0x400012) with
CastingTimeIndex 5 (SpellCastTimes 2000 ms). SpellInfo::CalcCastTime adds the 500 ms ranged preparation, so the
server casts it in 2500 ms before haste while the client's SpellCastTimes row keeps 2000 ms; the report saw a
1.63 s tooltip against a 2 s cast, which is the same mismatch the Witch Doctor and Barbarian ranged-slot fixes
answered. The client patch stream now publishes a Spell.dbc row for the ability whose CastingTimeIndex points at
the 2500 ms row (19), so the client's tooltip and cast bar use the time the server casts. The server's own cast
time is unchanged. Stock Hunter Steady Shot 34120 is not registered and receives no cast-time row.

steps.label: Let login and the client patch stream settle
DISCRIMINATING: the client receives 2500 ms for Incendiary Shot
The streamed row keeps the Incendiary Shot attributes
The server still casts Incendiary Shot in 2000 + 500 ms
An unregistered stock ranged shot receives no cast-time row
